_collectionTitle: Appears in board titles and on the methodology page. Set it before the first import.
_seasonId: A season is a scope, not a reset. Every board states which season it belongs to, and a season boundary is the cleanest effective date for a rules change.
_rulesetPrefix: A source app stamps its own build as, say, 'v1.3', which is unambiguous inside that app but not here — another source could also reach v1.3. This prefix qualifies a bare stamp into a ruleset id declared in rulesets.json. An already-qualified stamp is used as-is.
_rulesetVersion: Fallback for exports taken before the source app began stamping AppVersion. Leave null once every export carries a stamp; set it only if you must import an unstamped export, and declare that id in rulesets.json first.
_promptVersion: Which extraction prompt version produced the underlying parses. Published on the board for traceability; null until you version prompts.
_minPicks: Below this many resolved predictions a participant is provisional, and sinks to the bottom of the skill-ordered boards rather than topping them on one lucky pick.
_cardLimit: How many rows reach the news card. The full board always reaches standings.json regardless, and the slice extends through a tie group at the cut line.
_columnMap: Only needed when the source export labels a column differently from the logical name the importer reads. Example: { "Points": "FinalPoints", "Edge": "SkillEdge", "Resolved": "Predictions" }. Mapping is additive — the original headers stay on the row — and a source that already uses the logical names needs no entry at all.
